title: Pit Fired Ceramics Workshop with Eniko Ujj and Nick Phoenix
how_to_join: Register via Square link or Facebook Event Page
summary: A hands-on pit firing workshop for 30 participants on November 14, 2026 at Native Plant Company in Milton, FL. Learn pit firing history and process, decorate pre-made pieces with natural materials, and participate in loading, igniting, and uncovering the pit.
source_quote: Join Florida-based artists Eniko Ujj and Nick Phoenix on November 14, 2026, for a hands-on exploration of pit firing
evidence_sentence: The workshop page describes a pit firing workshop where participants decorate pre-made ceramic pieces and participate in loading, igniting, and uncovering the pit.
evidence_quote: Participate in loading, igniting, and uncovering the pit
